title: Code Review Findings
description: Return contract for a lens sub-agent. The sub-agent returns this JSON in its final message — there is no artifact file.

findings.description: Review findings. Empty array if none.

title.description: Short, specific issue title. 10 words or fewer.

severity.description: Severity per review-verification-protocol. Critical: security vuln, data corruption, happy-path crash, broken public contract. Major: logic bug affecting functionality, missing error handling, measurable perf/a11y issue. Minor: clarity, docs, non-critical coverage. Informational: net-new code requests, future ideas, optimizations with no measurable impact — excluded from the actionable count.

why_it_matters.description: Observable behavior first — what breaks and who is hit, not a restatement of the code. 2-4 sentences plus the minimum quoted code.

confidence.description: Anchored confidence. 0: false positive or pre-existing — do not emit. 25: speculative, unverifiable from the diff — do not emit. 50: verified but minor/uncertain — surfaces only when Critical or routed to a soft bucket. 75: highly confident, will affect users/callers/runtime in normal usage — actionable. 100: verifiable from the code alone (compile/type error, definitive logic bug, quotable standards violation).

evidence.description: Code-grounded evidence, >=1 item. For any finding at anchor 75 or 100, the FIRST item MUST be the verbatim motivating line(s) with file:line — the quote-the-line gate. A finding whose trigger cannot be quoted steps down to anchor 50.

suggested_fix.description: Concrete minimal fix defensible from the diff, parallel patterns, or framework conventions. Propose one whenever any defensible change is reachable; name any assumption rather than punting. Omit only when there is no code-level change to propose (the finding is a question, or the resolution is purely organizational).

requires_verification.description: True when a fix for this finding needs targeted tests or a follow-up review before it can be trusted.

pre_existing.description: True only for issues in unchanged code unrelated to this diff. If the diff makes the issue newly relevant, it is NOT pre-existing.

residual_risks.description: Risks noticed but not confirmed as findings

_meta.return_note: The full return above IS what the sub-agent sends in its final message. The orchestrator merges from these returns — no run-id, no /tmp artifact tree. For the quote-the-line gate the orchestrator reads evidence[0] directly from the return.
_meta.confidence_gate: Governs the actionable tier only (Critical/Major/Minor competing to surface). Below anchor 75 they are suppressed, except Critical at 50+ so critical-but-uncertain issues are not silently dropped; 75/100 are actionable. Informational findings and the residual_risks/testing_gaps buckets are non-actionable and reported in their own sections regardless of anchor — the gate does not apply to them.
_meta.net_new_overlay: A finding requesting code that did not exist before (new module, test suite, abstraction, dependency) is Informational and excluded from the actionable count, regardless of merit.
